defaultQuery: How does the employee equipment return process work?

lastResult.answer: Employees must return company equipment within five business days of their last working day. The People Operations team provides a prepaid shipping label for remote employees.

chunks.text: Company laptops, badges, and peripherals must be returned within five business days of the last working day. Remote employees receive a prepaid shipping label from People Operations.
IT confirms receipt of returned hardware before closing the offboarding ticket. Missing accessories are billed to the cost center.
Access badges are deactivated at 17:00 on the last working day. Physical return can follow within the five-day window.
